reviews.disposition: F1–F5 distinguish existing body/source/packing, ordinary potion and custody APIs from an unimplemented body-edit contract. Keep original main versus P2 worktree paths and inherited test receipts separate; sibling code is not an adopted API merely because it was read. No general source/graft handler is established by metadata or an empty authoring grant. Sample receipt/provenance and consumed references must remain valid after current quantity is zero. Prior raw tails have unknown donor/time rather than invented attribution. Positive capabilities cannot become signed penalty multipliers, and an origin label cannot transmit skill. Reference mutation/genepack/serum descriptions are dated, version-specific support, not actual B11 heritable mechanics, current installed values or universal hunger/flaw law. No new external reference/source reading occurs here.
reviews.evidence: Complete original audit read, all source/reference rows and explicit limits. Original runtime and external sources not reread or recertified.
reviews.reopen: Only selected edit consumer/source contradiction needs exact current source/adapter review; preserve separate P2 provenance.

reviews.classification: complete original modification proposal with retained lifecycle/identity constraints
reviews.disposition: Full G53-B11.1–.11 review retains the original clinic as an unselected public example. Keep the read/buy/stabilize/assay/apply/repair/rest/reverse distinctions, optional diagnosis and known blind risk, finite actual unit custody versus stock labels, held versus spent inputs and mode-specific somatic/template state. Three clinic vials/bark/phials/prices, C/M/S limits, outcome percentages, duration and body eligibility are authored local dials, not project-wide restrictions. The new sample key must pass every inventory/transfer/loader adapter; ordinary JSON key validity is insufficient. B2 revision2, body_modification_archive and named native/UI modules are proposed owners, not admitted formats or available APIs. Keep immutable template snapshots and cause/outcome/card/source bindings, exact target compare-and-swap reversal, current-body versus future-transmission removal and already-conceived descendants. A 50/75-percent allele fixture is not naturally played conception or general inheritance. Reserve a source only for its actual acquisition owner; max-one grip/one-archetype binding is the candidate’s selected function, not universal strength balancing. Preview/assay/display must not reroll, allocate a cause or expose hidden outcome through errors. Time progresses on the host scheduler with the panel closed; its own treatment job must not block its own settlement under an ambiguous “idle” check. Cancellation/refund and support-forced pause use performed work, held/spent state and exact body identity. New-life/body replacement keeps surviving referenced stock/history without activating the old body’s source. RNG readiness is a named integration question, not a missing-universal-service assumption. Current selected seeded_streams.js already supplies saved roots, scoped/keyed decisions and receipts, with admitted families; bare body.modify/body.gen families are not admitted by that registry. Prefer the existing suitable owner/family or an explicit registry change at the selected consumer. Do not add the proposed legacy entropy root merely because the October P1 integration was unconfirmed. Root initialization/receipt-writing helpers and pure unitDecision differ, so “no draw on preview” also needs state purity. Current 32-bit outcome mapping and frozen result remain a proposal until bound/tested. Legacy migration cases are optional, current state literal persistence still required. Neither a schema default nor a source-only matrix closes native procurement/use/reversal or actual heredity; no implementation or source expansion is selected.
reviews.evidence: All 637 original lines read in eight bounded spans including JSON, capacity/outcome/transmission arithmetic, reversal/clock, UI and migration. Selected current seeded_streams.js 1–22 and 38–64 inspected for root/family/purity uncertainty; no new runtime proof.
reviews.reopen: A later selected clinic or other body-edit consumer must bind current owners and its own source/native/failure/persistence checks. No source tree, saves or private packs changed.
